player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Mastermind.
You need to find the code that is {code_length} digits long, each digit from 1 to {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
In your response, you can submit your guess in the following format: '[2 1 4 5]'.
After each guess, you will receive feedback in the form of black and white pegs.
A black peg indicates a correct digit in the correct position, while a white peg indicates a correct digit in the wrong position.
You have {max_turns} turns to guess the code.
player_prompt.with_repeats: kek lëu bï röt bɛɛr looi.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: cïn kë ye kek thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ thïn

invalid_move.not_integers: Kä ye kek gɔ̈ɔ̈r ëbën adhil ya nimirai ke path.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Kë ye yök adhil tɔ̈u në nimira {code_length} yic.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kä ye kek yök adhil tɔ̈u në kaam de 1 ku {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Akuɔ̈tnhïïm ye kek mat në nimirai kɔ̈k yiic aacïï ke puɔ̈l.

outcome.turn_limit: Ye kë ye yök ke cë rɔt waar. Yïn acï {percent}% de nimira yic them apath.
